message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: defendant set fire to a house, causing property damage, but no serious consequences (no death). This is arson (放火). In Chinese criminal law, article 114 (or 115?) "放火罪" (arson) – causing property damage, endangering public safety. So the crime is "放火". In examples, they used "放火" as answer for arson. For example earlier: "吴某 ... 放火". So answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes? Possibly "故意毁坏财物" but they used "放火". The prosecution says "故意放火焚烧他人财物，危害公共安全". So the crime is arson. So final answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>
